d: Still crouching, she slides the glowing katana further across in front of her face; cyan sparks trail along the blade; camera slightly closer.
The camera pushes in fast: she is between a full crouching shot and a chest-up close-up, katana held level across her face, speed lines converging.
She bursts out of the close-up: the camera whips back as she spins down into a crouch, the katana starting a cyan arc, lightning crackling, motion-blurred.
Mid-spin: her body twists further, the cyan katana arc wraps around her, lightning sparks; camera a bit wider than image 1.
Camera pulls back to reveal the neon street with the torii gate; she launches into a low forward lunge, katana trailing a cyan arc.
Lunging forward over the wet street, a faint cyan afterimage clone separating from her back, splashes under her feet.
The row of rainbow afterimage clones begins stretching into diagonal light streaks shooting up toward the upper right while she is still crouched.
The three light streaks rise higher; three fighter silhouettes (cyan, white, magenta) climb along them and spread apart.
The ring of clones tightens toward the center; their glowing katanas point inward and the light between them intensifies.
The white flash dissipates into sparks; the girl spins outward with her katana trailing a wide cyan-magenta arc.
She leaps diagonally across the frame with a sweeping slash; the first magenta slash line starts to cut across behind her.
The camera begins to push toward her as she follows through the X slash; the X glow fades slightly, RGB split.
Whip zoom toward her grinning face; the X slash is blurred behind her and the katana sweeps across the foreground.
She spirals upward faster inside the cyan-magenta light helix between the neon buildings, getting smaller.
She shoots up into the sky above the rooftops in front of the huge moon, the light helix stretching below; lightning begins to swirl.
Lightning swirls tighter around her in front of the giant moon; plasma begins gathering at the tip of her raised katana.
The giant laser blade fully extends to the left; the swirling lightning starts to clear; camera beginning to pull back from the moon.
Camera continues pulling back: she becomes smaller in front of the moon, the giant glowing sword held out horizontally, the city skyline below.
She raises the giant laser sword up and back over her head, preparing to swing; lightning crackles along the blade.
The giant laser sword is at the top of the swing and starts to come down, leaving a wide curved cyan-magenta trail.
The light pillar thins and flickers; the shockwave ring spreads outward and smoke starts billowing up from the crater.
In the smoke, her silhouette drops down from the sky toward the street, katana in hand, cyan sparks around her.
Kneeling in the smoke, the lightning on her katana dims and she begins to lift her head.
Still kneeling, she sweeps the katana back toward her shoulder with a smaller cyan arc; the robot cat flies closer from the right.
She finishes standing up, the katana arriving on her shoulder with a fading cyan arc; camera almost at medium shot; the robot cat floats upper right.
